notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content: [p]The Demo of "Empires of a Tiny Universe" is now available and contains the tutorial, two campaign missions and one random map (with restricted configuration options), as well as one of the three factions, the "Hoomans".[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: First Steam Playtest
notes.content:
To ensure that the game is of high quality, we need your feedback. Therefore, the first playtest version is now available. 

The playtest initially includes the tutorial, the first campaign mission and some of the random maps for custom skirmishes against the AI with one of the factions, the Hoomans.

Participants will be gradually unlocked for the playtest and constructive feedback is welcome in the Steam Community area or Discord. Especially interesting are suggestions for improvements to the gameplay, interface, level design etc. as well as reports of bugs should they exist.
